regions.original: 毎日限定 ロースカツカレー 880円
regions.translation: Daily Special: Loin Cutlet Curry, 880 Yen
regions.romanization: Mainichi Gentei Ro-su Katsu Kare- Happyaku Hachijū En
regions.breakdown: 毎日 (mainichi) means 'every day'. 限定 (gentei) means 'limited', indicating a daily limited offer. ロース (ro-su) is 'loin' (from English 'roast' or 'loin'). カツ (katsu) is 'cutlet' (from English 'cutlet'). カレー (kare-) is 'curry'. 880円 (happyaku hachijū en) is the price, 880 Japanese Yen.
チキン (chikin) means 'chicken'. オム (omu) is a shortened form of オムレツ (omuretsu), meaning 'omelet'. カレー (kare-) means 'curry'. This is a popular combination dish.

where_youd_see_it: On a menu board or special offer sign outside a restaurant.
cultural_note: Japanese curry is a beloved comfort food, often served with rice. Tonkatsu (pork cutlet) and omelets are very common toppings for curry, reflecting a blend of Western and Japanese culinary influences. 'C&C' is a popular curry chain in Japan, especially common in train stations.
